newsitem.title: POLAND: PEKPOL REVISES DOWN '97 NET PROFIT VIEW.
newsitem.headline: PEKPOL REVISES DOWN '97 NET PROFIT VIEW.

text.p: Polish food producer Pekpol SA has revised down its 1997 net profit forecast to 2.18 million zlotys from the 2.53 million forecast earlier this year, the company said in a statement on Friday.
Pekpol revised down its sales forecast to 202.8 million zlotys from 247.7 million zlotys.
The firm said the move was due to a longer-than-expected pause in production at its butchering division in the town of Garwolin and higher import costs due to the rising dollar.
Pekpol netted 0.02 million zlotys in this year's first half against 1.9 million in first-half 1996.
January-June sales were down slightly to 92.5 million zlotys from 95.3 million.
